lines.zh: 难以置信……

lines.en: : She knows exactly what she’s doing here. She knows what I’m going to think, but it’s like she doesn’t even care.
lines.zh: 她很清楚自己在这儿干什么。她知道我会怎么想，可她好像根本不在乎。

lines.en: : Well...she probably doesn’t. This is Nodoka we’re talking about. I’m pretty sure feelings are a thing she doesn’t actually...you know, {i}have.{/i}
lines.zh: 嗯……她大概确实不在乎。我们说的可是 Nodoka。我很确定「感情」这种东西她其实根本不……你知道的，{i}没有{/i}。

lines.en: : How did I get here? I was with Touka just a second ago.
lines.zh: 我怎么到这儿来的？我一分钟前还跟 Touka 在一起。

lines.en: : I assume your legs had something to do with it. I’ve found they’re typically the device that brings me from one place to the other. But that’s probably just because I can’t drive yet.
lines.zh: 我猜大概跟你的腿有关。我发现它们通常就是把我从一个地方带到另一个地方的装置。不过那大概只是因为我还没到能开车的年纪。

lines.en: : You’ve...been with Touka a lot tonight...
lines.zh: 你……今晚跟 Touka 待在一起的时间好长……
然后呢？
然后……我……呃……

lines.en: : I guess...I don’t have anything to...add to that...
lines.zh: 我猜……我没什么要……补充的……

lines.en: : I just...thought it was...a little strange...
lines.zh: 我只是……觉得……有点奇怪……

lines.en: : Yeah, we’ve all kind of noticed that. Just no one has really said or done anything about it because pretty much all of us love her and think she’s way out of your league.
lines.zh: 是啊，我们其实都注意到了。只是没人真的说什么或做什么，因为我们基本都喜欢她，而且觉得她远远不是你能配得上的。

lines.en: : All of you are out of my league but that won’t stop me from having sex with you one day.
lines.zh: 你们所有人都我配不上，但那不会妨碍我有一天跟你们上床。

lines.en: : Knock it off! This is hardly the time to joke around like that!
lines.zh: 够了！现在可不是开这种玩笑的时候！
我不……

lines.en: : There’s no need to respond, Sana. Like Futaba said, that was just a joke. And I don’t intend to have sex with any of you because I’m a good guy and good guys don’t have sex with high school girls.
lines.zh: 不用回应，Sana。就像 Futaba 说的，那只是个玩笑。我也不打算跟你们任何人发生关系，因为我是个好人，而好人不跟高中女生上床。
你在干什么？

lines.en: : What do you mean, “What are you doing?”
lines.zh: 你问「你在干什么」是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean what happened to your filter?
lines.zh: 我是说你的过滤器哪去了？

lines.en: : I gave it to Yumi as a birthday present. I figure it will help her from saying anything else that leads to her getting sexually assaulted in locker rooms going forward.
lines.zh: 我把它当生日礼物送给 Yumi 了。我觉得那能帮上她，免得她以后再说出什么导致自己在更衣室里被性侵的话。
我说够了！

lines.en: Futaba yells at me. But Futaba {i}never{/i} yells at me, so this is probably just a dream. Which means that I should do my rounds again and have sex with everybody before I wake up so no one feels left out.
lines.zh: Futaba 冲我吼。但 Futaba {i}从来不{/i}冲我吼，所以这大概只是个梦。也就是说，我应该再巡一圈，在醒过来之前跟所有人都上床，这样就不会有人觉得被冷落了。
那么，谁第一个？
fuck futobo
你的幸运数字是 46782
do sex ron
你的幸运数字是 99635
rape santa
你的幸运数字是 392354

lines.en: : Sensei, it’s one thing for you to happily dismiss everything Nodoka is doing because {i}you don’t care,{/i} but would you maybe consider thinking about those of us that {i}do?{/i}
lines.zh: Sensei，你因为{i}自己不在乎{/i}就乐得把 Nodoka 做的一切都打发掉，这是一回事，但你能不能也替我们这些{i}在乎{/i}的人想一想？

lines.en: : I feel sick to my stomach that she’d stoop this low all for the sake of...collecting information. And if you’re just going to be mean about it-
lines.zh: 一想到她为了……收集情报就能下作到这种地步，我就觉得反胃。而如果你还要对此刻薄的话-
对不起。
我不知道发生了什么。
嗯……好吧。

lines.en: : But still, you shouldn’t say things like...that thing you said a minute ago. If one of us took it the wrong way, you could get into a lot of trouble.
lines.zh: 但还是，你不该说那种……你刚才说的那种话。要是我们谁会错了意，你会惹上大麻烦的。

lines.en: : I...I think Sensei...means it when...he says he’s sorry...and...um...
lines.zh: 我……我觉得 Sensei……说对不起的时候是……真心的……而且……嗯……
我不会……我不会……告诉别人的，如果……嗯……
对……对不起……只是……呃……穿着这身……衣服好热……而且……呃……
我……我……真的……
我懂了。

lines.en: : Get {i}what?{/i} I don’t think the “joke” was very hard to understand.
lines.zh: 懂{i}什么？{/i}我不觉得那个「玩笑」有多难理解。

lines.en: : No, I mean I get why he’s been with Touka all night. I’m just...
lines.zh: 不，我是说我明白他为什么整晚都跟 Touka 待在一起了。我只是……

lines.en: : I don’t think I can really say any more than that without making him feel worse.
lines.zh: 我觉得再说下去只会让他更难受。

lines.en: : Stop talking about me like I’m not here. If you have something to say to me, you can say it to my face.
lines.zh: 别当我不存在一样谈论我。有什么要对我说的，可以当面说。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll talk all about it while you’re walking me home. Go say goodbye to everyone.
lines.zh: 行啊。等你送我回家的时候我再好好跟你说。去跟大家道个别吧。
回家？你这就走了？

lines.en: : I might as well. Otoha’s not here, you’re mad at me, and I want to talk to Sensei for a little while. There’s not really any reason {i}for{/i} me to stick around.
lines.zh: 不如走了。Otoha 不在这儿，你在生我的气，而我想跟 Sensei 单独待一会儿。真没什么{i}理由{/i}让我留下来。
我……觉得……没那个必要……

lines.en: : {b}But I don’t want to go home. I want to party.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}可我不想回家。我想开派对。{/b}

lines.en: : Yeah, I get that. You love Halloween and costumes and blah, blah, blah.
lines.zh: 是啊，我知道。你喜欢万圣节，喜欢变装， blah blah blah。

lines.en: : But...Sensei, I {i}really{/i} think you might be better off somewhere else right now. This isn’t the...environment you want to be in when things get bad.
lines.zh: 但是……Sensei，我{i}真的{/i}觉得你眼下最好换个地方。事情变糟的时候，这儿可不是你想待的环境。

lines.en: : Bad how? There’s nothing bad about {b}being a party animal.{/b}
lines.zh: 糟什么糟？{b}当个派对动物{/b}有什么不好的。

lines.en: : S...Sensei is right! He should...stay here and...um...we should...keep...uhh...
lines.zh: S……Sensei 说得对！他应该……留在这儿，而且……嗯……我们应该……继续……呃……
他……他就该……留在这儿……

lines.en: : Sana, you’re not helping. Leave this to the person here with the most experience in mental breakdowns.
lines.zh: Sana，你这是在帮倒忙。这种事交给这里精神崩溃经验最丰富的人来处理吧。

lines.en: : Is that true, Sensei? Are you actually...going through something like that right now?
lines.zh: 是真的吗，Sensei？你现在真的……正在经历那种事吗？

lines.en: : No. I’m fine. I just have a {b}headache.{/b} A little water and some rest is all I need. {i}Then,{/i} I will be ready to party.
lines.zh: 不。我没事。我只是{b}头疼{/b}。喝点水、休息一下就行了。{i}然后{/i}，我就准备好开派对了。

lines.en: : S...See? He’s fine. He just needs some rest...
lines.zh: 看……看吧？他没事的。他只是需要休息……

lines.en: : New question — are {i}you{/i} doing okay, Sana? Because you’re acting a little strange right now too and I’m starting to think the lack of air in your costume might be messing with your head.
lines.zh: 换个问题——{i}你{/i}还好吗，Sana？因为你现在也有点怪，我开始怀疑是你那身衣服里缺氧，把你脑子搞坏了。
我……呃……其实……这么……一说，确实……

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} really hot in here and...I...uhh...I’m not sure...how much...longer I can...
lines.zh: 这里{i}真的{/i}很热，而且……我……呃……我不确定……还能撑多久……
咿！
天哪——Sana？！
太……热了……喘……不上……气……
那就把面具摘了！

lines.en: : Never fear. I will save her.
lines.zh: 别怕。我来救她。

lines.en: : How do you expect to save anyone in your current state? You can barely even think for yourself right now.
lines.zh: 你现在这副样子怎么救人？你连自己思考都快做不到了。
谢……谢谢你……Sensei……
我想……我……我需要……躺下来……

lines.en: : Woah, what’s going on? What happened? Is Sana okay? I told her she was going to die in that costume.
lines.zh: 哇哦，怎么了？出什么事了？Sana 还好吗？我早就说过她穿那身衣服会死的。
这……就是……这就是……终点了……

lines.en: : I will not let another girl die.
lines.zh: 我不会再让一个女孩死掉。

lines.en: : We need to take her somewhere cool. Do you have, like...a room we can get her {i}and{/i} Sensei some water in? Preferably somewhere we won’t get lost along the way to inside your labyrinth of a house?
lines.zh: 我们得把她带到凉快的地方去。你们有没有……什么房间能让她{i}和{/i} Sensei 都喝上水？最好是在你那迷宫一样的房子里不会迷路就能走到的。

lines.en: : There’s an infirmary down the hall and Geoffrey is a licensed general practitioner. Let me call him and-
lines.zh: 走廊那头有间医务室，Geoffrey 是有执照的全科医生。让我给他打个电话，然后-

lines.en: : I’ll...be fine with...a little rest...I just...have to lie down and...and change clothes...
lines.zh: 我……休息……一下就好了……我只要……躺下，然后……然后换件衣服……
那让我-
S……Sensei 可以……处理……

lines.en: : She is right. I have done this before. In the first chapter of the game.
lines.zh: 她说得对。我干过这个。在游戏的第一章里。
第……什么？
你应该记得的。
那很特别。

lines.en: : A...Anyway, the infirmary is the thirteenth door on the left-hand side of the fifth corridor. Just hug the right wall until you see a suit of armor with a cracked helmet and-
lines.zh: 总……总之，医务室是第五条走廊左手边第十三扇门。只要一直贴着右墙走，直到你看见一副头盔有裂纹的盔甲，然后-
明白了。

lines.en: : And...you’ll be there in no time at all...
lines.zh: 然后……你转眼间就到了……

lines.en: : What the actual fuck is going on right now? Everything was totally fine until, like...ten minutes ago.
lines.zh: 现在到底在搞什么鬼？十分钟之前一切都还好好的。

lines.en: : Go with them, please. This feels...weird.
lines.zh: 请你跟他们一起去。这感觉……很怪。

lines.en: : Me? This is your house. Shouldn’t {i}you{/i} be the one to go?
lines.zh: 我？这是你家。不该{i}你{/i}去吗？

lines.en: : I have my hands full already. Let’s just say that Sana and Sensei aren’t the only ones acting a little...strange.
lines.zh: 我这儿已经忙得不可开交了。这么说吧，Sana 和 Sensei 不是唯一几个表现得有点……奇怪的人。

lines.en: : Aaaaaah fine! Sensei, wait up! I don’t want to get lost in Ayane’s house again!
lines.zh: 啊啊啊好吧！Sensei，等等我！我可不想在 Ayane 家又迷路！

lines.en: Hug the right wall. Hug the right wall. Hug the right wall. Hug the right wall.
lines.zh: 贴着右墙走。贴着右墙走。贴着右墙走。贴着右墙走。

lines.en: : Sensei! Hold on! You’re walking way too fast!
lines.zh: Sensei！等等！你走得太快了！

lines.en: : Thirteenth door. Left-hand side. Fifth corridor. Hug the right wall.
lines.zh: 第十三扇门。左手边。第五条走廊。贴着右墙走。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad you remember the instructions because I sure as hell didn’t. But at least let me help you carry her.
lines.zh: 行，我很高兴你还记得指示，因为我是一点都没记住。但至少让我帮你抬着她。

lines.en: : Not needed. She’s light. I could carry ten of her and three of you all at the same time.
lines.zh: 不用。她很轻。我一次能扛十个她加三个你。

lines.en: : There is no way that is possible, but still! Slow down!
lines.zh: 这绝对不可能，但还是！慢点！

lines.en: I move my legs toward the place I’m supposed to move my legs toward.
lines.zh: 我把腿朝着该让腿去的方向移动。

lines.en: Rin and someone else follow me down the length of the hallway, but I’m too focused on preventing a death to pay either of them any mind apart from responding to their unimportant quips.
lines.zh: Rin 和另一个人跟着我穿过整条走廊，可我一心只想着阻止一场死亡，除了应付他们无关紧要的碎嘴，根本顾不上理会他们中的任何一个。

lines.en: Through layers and layers of fabric, I can tell that Sana is burning up. I watch her chest expand and shrink as her lungs take in and exchange air for a prolonged existence.
lines.zh: 隔着一层又一层的布料，我能感觉到 Sana 在发烫。我看着她的胸膛起伏，肺叶吸入并交换着空气，只为延续存在。

lines.en: It’s a reasonable trade. And I hope with every fiber of my shirt that I can continue to make it before being hooked up to a machine that makes all of my trades for me.
lines.zh: 这是笔合理的交易。我衬衫上的每一根纤维都在祈祷，希望在被接上一台替我完成所有交易的机器之前，我还能继续做下去。

lines.en: This party animal needs no iron lung — just a place to rest my head.
lines.zh: 这个派对动物不需要铁肺——只需要一个能让我把头搁下的地方。

lines.en: And as I open the thirteenth door on the left-hand side of the fifth corridor, I tell myself a joke.
lines.zh: 而当我打开第五条走廊左手边第十三扇门时，我给自己讲了个笑话。

lines.en: What’s black and white and red all over?
lines.zh: 什么东西黑白相间、又到处都是红的？

lines.en: The severed head of a dairy cow.
lines.zh: 一头奶牛被割下来的脑袋。

lines.en: {i}I remove a strange costume from the body of a little girl.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我从一个小女孩身上脱下一套奇怪的衣服。{/i}
她的皮肤很苍白。

lines.en: Soft, like the casing of a pillow fresh off of the clothesline.
lines.zh: 柔软，像刚从晾衣绳上取下来的枕套。

lines.en: It was sticky from sweat when I made contact with it. I watched her skin cling to my fingertips as if attempting to pull me back in.
lines.zh: 我触到它时，它被汗弄得黏糊糊的。我看着她的皮肤黏上我的指尖，仿佛想把我拉回去。

lines.en: There’s a bear on her panties.
lines.zh: 她的内裤上有只小熊。

lines.en: I assume she’s had them for a while. I know she hasn’t grown much.
lines.zh: 我猜她已经穿了很久了。我知道她没怎么长个儿。

lines.en: It’s cute, in the kind of way that makes you want to tear something to shreds.
lines.zh: 它很可爱，是那种让你想把什么东西撕成碎片的可爱。
但我克制住了。

lines.en: I am here to protect, not contaminate.
lines.zh: 我是来保护，不是来玷污的。

lines.en: I have long outgrown the bodies of angels.
lines.zh: 我早已长得不再适合天使的身体。
再说-
还有别人在看着。

lines.en: And thievery is quickly cut down while the lights are still on.
lines.zh: 而灯还亮着的时候，偷窃是很快就会被掐断的。
{i}Rin 为什么会在这里？！？！？{/i}
那……现在怎么办？

lines.en: : Do we just...wait for her to wake back up?
lines.zh: 我们就……等她醒过来？

lines.en: : You don’t have to stay here if you don’t want to. I can handle her alone.
lines.zh: 你不想待在这儿可以走。我一个人能搞定她。

lines.en: : Sensei, with all due respect, I’m not sure I trust you to handle {i}anything{/i} right now.
lines.zh: Sensei，恕我直言，我不确定现在我能放心让你处理{i}任何{/i}事。

lines.en: : Do you not like me anymore?
lines.zh: 你不再喜欢我了吗？

lines.en: : It’s obviously not that, jerk. It’s just-
lines.zh: 显然不是因为这个，混蛋。只是-

lines.en: : Stop staring at Sana’s butt and look at me when I’m talking to you!
lines.zh: 别再盯着 Sana 的屁股看了，我在跟你说话的时候看着我！

lines.en: : I think you’re, like...dissociating or something.
lines.zh: 我觉得你好像……在解离什么的。

lines.en: : It happens to me when I get depressed sometimes. You have to remember where you are and {i}who{/i} you are.
lines.zh: 我抑郁的时候有时会这样。你得记住自己在哪里、{i}自己是谁{/i}。

lines.en: : You gravitated to Touka since she’s like a mom, right? You’re feeling vulnerable and weak and so you’ve been clinging to her side because {i}that{/i} was the easiest way to keep yourself grounded.
lines.zh: 你往 Touka 身边靠，是因为她像个妈妈，对吧？你觉得自己脆弱又无力，所以一直黏在她身边，因为{i}那{/i}是让自己保持踏实最容易的办法。

lines.en: : So, let me ask you this — what can {i}I{/i} do? Do you want me to call her? Or will being alone with me for a little while be enough to get your currently-malfunctioning brain to start settling down?
lines.zh: 那我问你——{i}我{/i}能做点什么？你想让我打电话给她吗？还是说跟我单独待一会儿，就够让你那台正在故障的大脑开始平复下来？

lines.en: : Everyone seems to be noticing how broken I am today. It’s really demoralizing.
lines.zh: 今天好像所有人都看出来我有多破碎。真让人泄气。

lines.en: : Probably because everyone loves you, dummy. It’s easy for us to pick up when switches flip inside of your head because we’ve been watching you for years now.
lines.zh: 大概是因为大家都爱你吧，笨蛋。我们看了你这么多年，你脑子里开关一跳，我们很容易就察觉得到。
多少年？
多少什么？

lines.en: : How many years have you been watching me?
lines.zh: 你们看着我，看了多少年？

lines.en: : Uhh...is that really important right now?
lines.zh: 呃……这现在真的重要吗？

lines.en: : Listen...I’m not gonna make you talk because I hate it when people try to do that with me. I just want to know if I can help. So the offer still stands to walk me home once we’re certain Sana is still alive.
lines.zh: 听着……我不会逼你说，因为我讨厌别人对我这么做。我只是想知道我能不能帮上忙。所以等确认 Sana 还活着之后，你送我回家的提议依然有效。

lines.en: : What will we do when we get there?
lines.zh: 到了那儿我们要做什么？

lines.en: : Don’t make it weird, Sensei. You know I have a girlfriend.
lines.zh: 别搞得这么暧昧，Sensei。你知道我有女朋友的。

lines.en: : Do you ever wonder how things would be if she never showed up?
lines.zh: 你有没有想过，如果她从没出现过，一切会变成什么样？
因为我想过。

lines.en: : I try not to, but it happens. More than I’d like to admit.
lines.zh: 我尽量不去想，可还是会发生。比我自己愿意承认的要多。

lines.en: : When I was fucking Nodoka in the room next door to you, I was listening to your voice.
lines.zh: 我在你隔壁房间操 Nodoka 的时候，一直在听你的声音。

lines.en: : I was wishing that was me in there. That {i}I{/i} was the one you were having your “first sexual experience” with.
lines.zh: 我多希望里面那个人是我。希望{i}我{/i}才是那个和你一起经历「第一次性体验」的人。

lines.en: : Would that have made you happy?
lines.zh: 那样会让你幸福吗？
有关系吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. How do you think {i}I{/i} felt listening to Nodoka?
lines.zh: 我不知道。你觉得{i}我{/i}听着 Nodoka 的时候是什么感受？
大概就像你根本不在乎。
我说错了吗？
是啊。
是啊，你还真说错了。
Rin-

lines.en: : Are you still thirsty? I saw a vending machine down the hall and Sana’s probably dehydrated from being stuck inside that costume all day.
lines.zh: 你还渴吗？我在走廊那头看到一台自动售货机，Sana 被那身衣服闷了一整天，大概是脱水了。
我很抱歉-

lines.en: : I’ve heard you apologize more times in the last half hour than I have in...practically the rest of my life so far. But it’s fine. I know your head’s not on straight right now.
lines.zh: 过去半小时里我听你说对不起的次数，比我……这辈子其他时间加起来都多。不过没关系。我知道你现在的脑子不太正常。
我不是故意的-

lines.en: : Are you thirsty or not? I think we both need a little breather right now.
lines.zh: 你到底渴不渴？我觉得我们俩现在都需要喘口气。
来瓶水就挺好。
好。

lines.en: : If I close Sana’s privacy curtain, are you just going to open it back up to stare at her butt again?
lines.zh: 如果我把 Sana 的隔帘拉上，你会不会又拉开，好继续盯着她的屁股看？
大概会。

lines.en: : Then I will save myself the effort. Look, but don’t touch. Got it?
lines.zh: 那我就省省力气。只许看，不许碰。明白吗？

lines.en: : I’m surprised you’re okay with letting me look at all.
lines.zh: 你居然肯让我看，我还挺意外的。

lines.en: : Then you’ve clearly already forgotten who I am.
lines.zh: 那你显然已经忘了我是谁了。
我马上回来。

lines.en: : Wow. You trust me even less than I-
lines.zh: 哇。你对我的信任，竟然比我自己还少-
